name: Yahiko Tadanoshin
source:
He served Ryousuke's father, and even after his death, he is a competent butler who managed all the affairs of the Fusou family, including the inheritance procedures, without delay.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080224074935/http://www.gesakuza.co.jp/pc/index.htm]official website[/url]]
